{{Attr|Freeze}} (Variable) }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Redcliff Traitor''' was an enemy that appeared in [[The Classic Event]]. It had a high amount of health, higher than the [[Korblox Warrior (The Classic)|Korblox Warrior]], and a quick speed for its health, as it had similar speed to the [[Korblox Soul (The Classic)|Korblox Soul]]. ==Appearance== The '''Redcliff Traitor''' had tan and blue skin. It wore full body armor, which consisted of a helmet, chestplate, leggings, shoulder-pads and shoes. This armor was split into two halves. The first half was based around the armor worn by the Redcliff faction, while the second by the Korblox faction. The Redcliff part was colored red and gold while the Korblox part was colored dark blue and grey. The Korblox part also had multiple dark blue and blue horns on it. The emblems of the two factions were also visible on its armor. ==Strategy== *Multiple [[Soldier]]s and [[Militant]]s can clear these out quite easily. *High DPS towers like the [[Minigunner]], [[Accelerator]] or [[Engineer]] can be very effective against these. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} RedcliffTraitorSprint.gif|Walking animation (23 May 2024 – 12 March 2025) }} ==Trivia== *The '''Redcliff Traitor''' references the rivalry between the [[w:c:Roblox:Knights of RedCliff|Knights of RedCliff]] and [[w:c:Roblox:Korblox's Empire|Korblox's Empire]]. **Historically, members who defected to other factions, or were simply banished are called Renegades. ==Update History== *'''23 May 2024''' - [[v1.23.0]] **'''Redcliff Traitor''' added. *'''28 May 2024''' - [[v1.23.0|v1.23.3]] **'''Redcliff Traitor''' removed. *'''16 December 2024''' - [[v1.46.0]] **'''Redcliff Traitor''' re-added. *'''12 March 2025''' - [[v1.57.0]] **'''Redcliff Traitor''' removed. {{ClassicCandyCaneLane|[[Breaker2]]|Wave 5|Redcliff Traitor|Wave 6|[[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]]|Wave 7}} {{ClassicWinter|[[Korblox Warrior (The Classic)|Korblox Warrior]]|Wave 4|[[Breaker2]] & Redcliff Traitor|Wave 7|[[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]]|Wave 8}} {{ClassicIslandChaos|[[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]]|Wave 7|Redcliff Traitor & [[Korblox General (The Classic)|Korblox General]]|Wave 8|[[Breaker2]] & [[Breaker4]]|Wave 10}} {{ClassicCastle|[[Korblox General (The Classic)|Korblox General]]|Wave 8|Redcliff Traitor, [[Breaker4]] & [[Slow Boss]]|Wave 10|[[Korblox Deathwalker (The Classic)|Korblox Deathwalker]]|Wave 12}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Redcliff Traitor}}
